operators.name: custom_conv_transpose1d
semantics: 对应参考语句 x = F.conv_transpose1d(x, weight=self.conv_transpose1d.weight, bias=self.conv_transpose1d.bias, stride=self.conv_transpose1d.stride, padding=self.conv_transpose1d.padding, output_padding=self.conv_transpose1d.output_padding)
实现 ConvTranspose1d 的前向计算，使用 cuDNN 实现，保持 axes、strides、稳定顺序、边界行为与参考一致
参数按位置传入：input, weight, bias, stride, padding, output_padding
bias 可为 None，此处参考传入实际 bias 张量，因此扩展必须支持非 None bias
返回形状为 [N, out_channels, (L_in-1)*stride - 2*padding + kernel_size + output_padding]

operators.name: custom_pow
semantics: 对应参考语句 x = torch.pow(x, self.exponent)
逐元素计算 input 的 exponent 次幂，返回张量与输入同 shape、dtype、device
支持任意 strides，不改变布局

reference_steps.source: x = F.conv_transpose1d(x, weight=self.conv_transpose1d.weight, bias=self.conv_transpose1d.bias, stride=self.conv_transpose1d.stride, padding=self.conv_transpose1d.padding, output_padding=self.conv_transpose1d.output_padding)
semantics: 执行 ConvTranspose1d，输入形状 [128, 3, 16384]，weight 形状 [3, 16, 3]，bias 形状 [16]，stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1
使用 cuDNN 实现，保持数值精度与参考一致
对 ConvTranspose1d 输出逐元素求 exponent=2.0 次幂
